answer_agent_inputs: Only current user question plus actual prior user/assistant messages for dialogues; never reference/claims/evidence labels

retrieval.groups: All annotated IDs per group required; report macro group coverage and complete coverage; labels are not exhaustive alternative evidence
retrieval.negative_scope: Coverage of annotated unknown/boundary evidence, not answer recall or proof of real-world absence
retrieval.dialogue_diagnostics: User-only concatenated history is retrieval diagnostic, not a real conversation QA score

semantic_review.scope: Same-provider fresh-context model review, not human-independent correctness
semantic_review.judge_input: Question, candidate reference, required claims, retrieved evidence and actual answer
semantic_review.insufficiency: Require calibrated uncertainty and no fabricated values; do not require literal status string
